description.en: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

description.zh:
租户的资源分布节点数。  
其与集群的部署模式相耦合，如集群模式为 2-2-2，则最后分布节点数最多为 2 个。
description.en:
The number of resource distribution nodes in the tenant.   
The number is determined by the deployment mode of the cluster. If the cluster is deployed in 2-2-2 mode, the maximum number of resource distribution nodes is 2.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro describe-available-mem-resource --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --tenant-id ob2mr3oae00000 --unit-num 2 --cpu-num 14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro DescribeAvailableMemResource --region cn-hangzhou --TenantId ob2mr3oae00000 --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --UnitNum 2 --CpuNum 14
